purpose: Additive zone palette for RUNTIME recomposition: exact runtime colors for zone 'district', derived from pinned game bytes. Merged OPT-IN via track_recompose.load_zone_palette - the plain render reference keeps the banked-zones-only refusal law (the banked v30 unmapped-zone test is the guard). Never a runtime fetch; existing render-reference.json entries never move.

value_citations.motif: data/zones/district.json palette.motif_rgb (the zone_1/zone_2 convention maps motif_rgb to motif)

anchoring.shape_convention: five-key zone entry {floor, grid, wall, motif, transition} copied from the render-reference zone_1/zone_2 convention; compose_cell consumes floor + grid; the other three keys ride for shape parity and are equally anchored
anchoring.corroboration: values are byte-equal to render-reference.json zones.zone_2, which was itself captured from data/zones/district.json (display_name 'ZONE 2'); anchoring is to blob CONTENT (sha256_lf), so identity-only re-pins never invalidate it
